title: Descending a model localization to a small finite etale principal cover
statement:
Let $A$ be a Noetherian domain, $K'$ a field with an $A$-algebra structure [def-pc-field-extension], $0
e c_0\in A$, $S_0\subset K'$ an $A$-subalgebra which is $A[1/c_0]$, and $A_0\subset K'$ an $S_0$-subalgebra finite etale over $S_0$ [pqf-lem-finite-integral-lft, def-weil-etale-morphism], with fraction field $K'$. Assume the maps $A	o S_0	o A_0	o K'$ commute and the spectrum map $\operatorname{Spec}(A_0)	o\operatorname{Spec}(S_0)$ is surjective [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. For every $0
e t\in A_0$ there exist $0
e s\in A_0$ divisible by $t$, $0
e c\in A$, and a commutative domain $A'$ in the universe of $A$, with compatible maps $A	o A[1/c]	o A'$ and $A	o A_0	o A'	o K'$. The ring $A'$ is a localization $A_0[1/s]$, finite etale over $A[1/c]$, has fraction field $K'$, and its spectrum map to $\operatorname{Spec}(A[1/c])$ is surjective.

proof.text: Apply IsIntegral.of_finite to t, pass to IsIntegral.isAlgebraic, and use IsAlgebraic.exists_nonzero_dvd with t in the nonZeroDivisors of the domain A0. Obtain a nonzero a in S0 with t dividing algebraMap S0 A0 a. The subalgebra embeddings into K prime and the scalar tower imply algebraMap S0 A0 is injective, so s = algebraMap S0 A0 a is nonzero.

Set S = Localization.Away a and T = Localization.Away s. Give T its S-algebra structure by IsLocalization.Away.map and verify IsScalarTower S0 S T by IsLocalization.map_eq. Module.Finite.of_isLocalization proves T finite over S. The domain structure follows from Localization.Away.isDomain. Define T to K prime using IsLocalization.Away.lift of the canonical map A0 to K prime, and prove its scalar tower by lift_comp. IsFractionRing.isFractionRing_of_isDomain_of_isLocalization gives fraction field K prime.

Let b be the numerator from IsLocalization.Away.sec c0 a and c = c0*b. associated_sec_fst shows algebraMap A S0 b is associated to a; hence b is nonzero and mul_of_associated makes S a localization of A at c. Use IsLocalization.algEquiv to identify S with R = Localization.Away c. Define the R-algebra structure on T by composing the inverse equivalence with S to T; verify scalar towers and transport Module.Finite using of_equiv_equiv. Algebra.Etale.of_isLocalizationAway, comp, and of_restrictScalars prove T etale over R.

Module.Finite.small over the Type u ring R proves Small.{u} T. Take the concrete ring A prime = Shrink.{u} T, with its transported algebra structures. Define A prime to K prime by the shrink ring equivalence followed by T to K prime. Verify the scalar towers through the shrink algebra equivalences. Transport localization using IsLocalization.isLocalization_of_algEquiv, finiteness by its Shrink instance, etaleness by Algebra.Etale.of_equiv, and the fraction-field structure by IsFractionRing.isFractionRing_iff_of_base_ringEquiv.

The localization map S to T is injective by IsLocalization.Away.map_injective_iff and injectivity of S0 to A0. Composing with the base localization equivalence and the shrink equivalence proves the R to A prime map injective. Hence it is a faithful finite algebra; Algebra.IsIntegral.comap_surjective gives spectrum surjectivity. Assemble s, its divisibility and nonvanishing, c, and the concrete A prime with all these structures.

theorem exists_descend_model_localization
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsDomain A]
    (K' : Type (max u v)) [Field K'] [Algebra A K']
    (c0 : A) (hc0 : c0 ≠ 0) (S0 : Subalgebra A K')
    [IsLocalization.Away c0 S0] (A0 : Subalgebra S0 K')
    [Algebra A A0] [IsScalarTower A S0 A0] [IsScalarTower A A0 K']
    [Module.Finite S0 A0] [Algebra.Etale S0 A0] [IsFractionRing A0 K']
    (hsurj : Surjective (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap S0 A0))))
    (t : A0) (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (s : A0), t ∣ s ∧ s ≠ 0 ∧
      ∃ (c : A) (A' : Type u) (_ : CommRing A') (_ : Algebra (Localization.Away c) A')
        (_ : Algebra A A') (_ : IsScalarTower A (Localization.Away c) A')
        (_ : IsDomain A') (_ : Algebra A' K') (_ : Algebra A0 A')
        (_ : IsScalarTower A A0 A') (_ : IsScalarTower A0 A' K')
        (_ : IsLocalization.Away s A'),
        c ≠ 0 ∧ Module.Finite (Localization.Away c) A' ∧
          Algebra.Etale (Localization.Away c) A' ∧ IsFractionRing A' K' ∧
          Surjective (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (Localization.Away c) A')))
